title: Slovakian Porridge with Wholesome Genmaicha Crunch
description: A hearty breakfast dish that combines the traditional Slovakian porridge with the nutty flavor of genmaicha tea.

ingredients.name: rolled oats
ingredients.notes: old-fashioned or rolled oats work best

ingredients.name: genmaicha tea
ingredients.notes: loose-leaf or tea bags work fine

ingredients.name: walnuts
ingredients.notes: chopped or sliced, adds nice crunch

instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring the water to a boil.
Add the rolled oats and reduce the heat to low.
Add the genmaicha tea to the oats and stir well.
Stir in the honey until dissolved.
Serve the porridge hot, topped with sliced lemon and chopped walnuts.
